card.name: Linking words before HIV drug names
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation (of, including, except, an opening parenthesis, a colon) right before an HIV antiretroviral drug name is expected. Seen in HIV drug labels, especially before names like emtricitabine, tenofovir, darunavir or tipranavir.

modes.label: Component of a combination
modes.description: The word "of" after "component(s)" just before a combination product's drug names.
modes.example: TDF, a component<< of>> emtricitabine, ril

modes.label: Lists and formulations
modes.description: A colon, parenthesis, or word like "except" or "including" right before a named antiviral drug or strength.

card.writes: No clear link to the promoted tokens; it seems to anticipate the start of an antiretroviral drug name.
card.plain: It marks the spot just before an HIV drug name is about to appear in the label text.
